# Clarity Chat - Complete API Reference

> Clarity Chat is a React component library for building AI chat interfaces with 200+ components, 95+ hooks, streaming support, RAG, and enterprise features. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

This document contains comprehensive API documentation for Clarity Chat optimized for AI consumption. It includes full type signatures, all props, return values, and code examples.

---

## Table of Contents

1. [Installation](#installation)
2. [Quick Start](#quick-start)
3. [Core Components](#core-components)
4. [Core Hooks](#core-hooks)
5. [Memory Package](#memory-package)
6. [Token Optimization Package](#token-optimization-package)
7. [Utilities](#utilities)
8. [Types](#types)

---

## Installation

```bash
# npm
npm install @clarity-chat/react

# pnpm
pnpm add @clarity-chat/react

# yarn
yarn add @clarity-chat/react
```

**Peer Dependencies:**
- React 18+ or React 19
- Tailwind CSS 3.4+

**Optional Packages:**
```bash
npm install @clarity-chat/memory @clarity-chat/token-optimization
```

---

## Quick Start

### 3-Line Chat (Recommended)

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function App() {
  return <ClarityChatApp api="/api/chat" />
}
```

### With Memory Enabled

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ memory: true }}
/>
```

### Enterprise Preset

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  preset="enterprise"
/>
```

### Using the Hook

```tsx
import { useClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ChatComponent() {
  const { messages, append, isLoading, error } = useClarityChat({
    api: '/api/chat',
    memory: { enabled: true, strategy: 'vector-store' }
  })

  return (
    <div>
      {messages.map(m => <div key={m.id}>{m.content}</div>)}
      <button onClick={() => append({ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' })}>
        Send
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

---

## Core Components

### ClarityChatApp

The unified App API component - the recommended entry point for most applications.

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  preset="default"
  features={{ memory: true, tools: true }}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ClarityChatAppProps {
  /** API endpoint URL (required) */
  api: string

  /** Preset configuration: 'default' | 'minimal' | 'enterprise' | 'developer' */
  preset?: ClarityAppPreset

  /** Feature flags */
  features?: ClarityFeatureFlags

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: MemoryConfig

  /** Token optimization configuration */
  tokenOptimization?: TokenOptimizationConfig

  /** Tools/function calling configuration */
  tools?: ToolsConfig

  /** RAG configuration */
  rag?: RAGConfig

  /** Safety configuration */
  safety?: SafetyConfig

  /** Observability configuration */
  observability?: ObservabilityConfig

  /** UI configuration */
  ui?: UIConfig

  /** Event callbacks */
  onEvent?: (event: ClarityEvent) => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Children for custom layouts */
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

interface ClarityFeatureFlags {
  memory?: boolean
  tokenOptimization?: boolean
  tools?: boolean
  rag?: boolean
  safety?: boolean
  observability?: boolean
}
```

---

### ClarityChat

The legacy all-in-one chat component with built-in streaming, memory, and theming.

```tsx
import { ClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ClarityChat
  api="/api/chat"
  memory={{ enabled: true, strategy: 'vector-store' }}
  theme="dark"
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ClarityChatProps extends UseClarityChatOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL (required) */
  api: string

  /** Optional chat ID for persistence */
  chatId?: string

  /** Optional className for the chat container */
  className?: string

  /** Custom empty state */
  emptyState?: React.ReactNode

  /** Header configuration */
  header?: ClarityChatHeaderProps

  /** Message action callbacks */
  messageActions?: ClarityChatMessageActionsProps

  /** Prompt configuration */
  prompts?: ClarityChatPromptsProps

  /** Rate limiting configuration */
  rateLimiting?: ClarityChatRateLimitingProps

  /** Show header with session info */
  showHeader?: boolean

  /** Session title */
  sessionTitle?: string

  /** Session subtitle */
  sessionSubtitle?: string

  /** Header actions */
  headerActions?: React.ReactNode

  /** Show message count badge */
  showMessageCount?: boolean

  /** Enable export functionality */
  onExport?: () => void

  /** Enable clear chat functionality */
  onClear?: () => void

  /** Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages */
  autoScroll?: boolean

  /** Theme for the chat interface */
  theme?: string

  /** Show token counter in input */
  showTokenCounter?: boolean

  /** Show network status indicator */
  showNetworkStatus?: boolean

  /** Enable message operations (edit, delete, branch) */
  enableMessageOperations?: boolean

  /** Memory strategy for conversation context */
  memoryStrategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo?: React.ErrorInfo) => void
}

interface ClarityChatHeaderProps {
  show?: boolean
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  actions?: React.ReactNode
  showMessageCount?: boolean
}

interface ClarityChatMessageActionsProps {
  onCopy?: (id: string, content: string) => void
  onFeedback?: (messageId: string, type: 'up' | 'down', comment?: string) => void
  onEdit?: (messageId: string) => void
  onRegenerate?: (messageId: string) => void
  onDelete?: (messageId: string) => void
}

interface ClarityChatPromptsProps {
  starterPrompts?: Array<{ text: string; category?: string }>
  enableSuggestions?: boolean
  maxSuggestions?: number
}

interface ClarityChatRateLimitingProps {
  enable?: boolean
  maxConcurrentRequests?: number
  maxQueueSize?: number
  showQueueStatus?: boolean
  compactQueueStatus?: boolean
  onRequestQueued?: (position: number, estimatedWaitMs: number) => void
  onRateLimited?: (resetAt: number) => void
  onQueueFull?: () => void
}
```

### ClarityChatPresets

Pre-configured chat variants for common use cases.

```tsx
import { ClarityChatPresets } from '@clarity-chat/react'

// Customer Support preset
<ClarityChatPresets.CustomerSupport api="/api/chat" />

// Code Assistant preset
<ClarityChatPresets.CodeAssistant api="/api/chat" />

// Enterprise preset
<ClarityChatPresets.Enterprise api="/api/chat" />

// Minimal preset
<ClarityChatPresets.Minimal api="/api/chat" />

// Creative preset
<ClarityChatPresets.Creative api="/api/chat" />
```

**Available Presets:**
- `CustomerSupport` - Optimized for customer service interactions
- `CodeAssistant` - Optimized for coding assistance with syntax highlighting
- `Enterprise` - Full features with audit logging and compliance
- `Minimal` - Lightweight, minimal UI
- `Creative` - Enhanced creative writing features
- `Documentation` - Optimized for documentation Q&A
- `Sales` - Optimized for sales conversations

### ChatWindow

Container component for chat messages with automatic scroll management.

```tsx
import { ChatWindow } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ChatWindow
  messages={messages}
  autoScroll={true}
  showScrollButton={true}
  virtualized={true}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChatWindowProps {
  /** Messages to display */
  messages: CoreMessage[]

  /** Scroll event callback */
  onScroll?: (event: React.UIEvent) => void

  /** Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages */
  autoScroll?: boolean

  /** Show scroll-to-bottom button */
  showScrollButton?: boolean

  /** Enable virtualization for large lists */
  virtualized?: boolean

  /** Group messages by sender */
  groupMessages?: boolean

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Custom message renderer */
  renderMessage?: (message: CoreMessage) => React.ReactNode

  /** Empty state content */
  emptyState?: React.ReactNode
}
```

### ChatInput

User input component with multi-line support, attachments, and voice input.

```tsx
import { ChatInput } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ChatInput
  value={input}
  onChange={setInput}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  placeholder="Type a message..."
  attachments={true}
  voiceInput={true}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChatInputProps {
  /** Current input value */
  value: string

  /** Value change handler */
  onChange: (value: string) => void

  /** Submit handler */
  onSubmit: () => void

  /** Placeholder text */
  placeholder?: string

  /** Enable file attachments */
  attachments?: boolean

  /** Enable voice input */
  voiceInput?: boolean

  /** Prompt suggestions */
  suggestions?: string[]

  /** Maximum input length */
  maxLength?: number

  /** Disabled state */
  disabled?: boolean

  /** Loading state */
  loading?: boolean

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string
}
```

### Message

Individual message display component.

```tsx
import { Message } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<Message
  message={message}
  showAvatar={true}
  showTimestamp={true}
  actions={['copy', 'edit', 'delete']}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface MessageProps {
  /** Message data */
  message: CoreMessage

  /** Message variant */
  variant?: 'default' | 'compact' | 'bubble'

  /** Show avatar */
  showAvatar?: boolean

  /** Show timestamp */
  showTimestamp?: boolean

  /** Available actions */
  actions?: Array<'copy' | 'edit' | 'delete' | 'regenerate'>

  /** Edit handler */
  onEdit?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Delete handler */
  onDelete?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Regenerate handler */
  onRegenerate?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string
}
```

### StreamingMessage

Real-time streaming response display.

```tsx
import { StreamingMessage } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<StreamingMessage
  content={streamingContent}
  isStreaming={true}
  showCursor={true}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface StreamingMessageProps {
  /** Current content */
  content: string

  /** Whether currently streaming */
  isStreaming: boolean

  /** Streaming speed (chars per second) */
  streamingSpeed?: number

  /** Render mode: 'character' | 'word' | 'line' */
  renderMode?: 'character' | 'word' | 'line'

  /** Show cursor animation */
  showCursor?: boolean

  /** Completion callback */
  onComplete?: () => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string
}
```

### ChainOfThought

Step-by-step AI reasoning visualization.

```tsx
import { ChainOfThought, useChainOfThought } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const { steps, addStep, updateStep } = useChainOfThought()

<ChainOfThought
  steps={steps}
  collapsed={false}
  showConfidence={true}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChainOfThoughtProps {
  /** Reasoning steps */
  steps: ChainOfThoughtStep[]

  /** Collapsed state */
  collapsed?: boolean

  /** Show confidence scores */
  showConfidence?: boolean

  /** Step click handler */
  onStepClick?: (step: ChainOfThoughtStep) => void

  /** Variant: 'default' | 'compact' | 'detailed' */
  variant?: ChainOfThoughtVariant

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string
}

interface ChainOfThoughtStep {
  id: string
  title: string
  content: string
  status: ChainOfThoughtStepStatus
  confidence?: number
  duration?: number
  children?: ChainOfThoughtStep[]
}

type ChainOfThoughtStepStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error'
```

### ToolExecutionCard

Display tool/function call execution.

```tsx
import { ToolExecutionCard, useToolExecution } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ToolExecutionCard
  tool={toolExecution}
  expanded={true}
/>
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ToolExecutionCardProps {
  /** Tool execution data */
  tool: ToolExecution

  /** Execution status */
  status?: ToolExecutionStatus

  /** Input parameters */
  input?: Record<string, unknown>

  /** Output result */
  output?: unknown

  /** Execution duration (ms) */
  duration?: number

  /** Expanded state */
  expanded?: boolean

  /** Toggle handler */
  onToggle?: () => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string
}

interface ToolExecution {
  id: string
  name: string
  description?: string
  parameters?: Record<string, unknown>
  result?: unknown
  status: ToolExecutionStatus
  startedAt?: Date
  completedAt?: Date
  error?: Error
}

type ToolExecutionStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error' | 'cancelled'
```

interface SourceCitationProps {

### MemoryProvider

Context provider for conversation memory management.

```tsx
import { MemoryProvider, useMemoryContext } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<MemoryProvider config={{ maxTokens: 10000, strategy: 'vector-store' }}>
  <ChatApp />
</MemoryProvider>

// In child component
const { memory, addMemory, searchMemory, clearMemory } = useMemoryContext()
```

**Props:**

```typescript
interface MemoryProviderProps {
  /** Memory configuration */
  config?: MemoryConfig

  /** Memory strategy */
  strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'

  /** Maximum tokens for context */
  maxTokens?: number

  /** Storage backend */
  storage?: 'memory' | 'indexeddb' | 'custom'

  /** Children */
  children: React.ReactNode
}

interface UseMemoryContextReturn {
  /** Current memory items */
  memory: MemoryItem[]

  /** Add item to memory */
  addMemory: (content: string, metadata?: MemoryMetadata) => Promise<void>

  /** Search memory */
  searchMemory: (query: string, options?: SearchOptions) => Promise<MemorySearchResult[]>

  /** Clear all memory */
  clearMemory: () => Promise<void>

  /** Context window information */
  contextWindow: ContextWindowInfo

  /** Memory statistics */
  stats: MemoryStats
}
```

---

## Core Hooks

### useClarityChatApp

Unified App API hook - the recommended hook for most applications.

```tsx
import { useClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const {
  messages,
  append,
  reload,
  stop,
  isLoading,
  error,
  // Memory
  memory,
  // Tools
  tools,
  pendingToolCalls,
  // Token optimization
  tokenStats,
  // Meta information
  meta
} = useClarityChatApp({
  api: '/api/chat',
  features: { memory: true, tools: true }
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatAppOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL */
  api: string

  /** Preset configuration */
  preset?: ClarityAppPreset

  /** Feature flags */
  features?: ClarityFeatureFlags

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: MemoryConfig

  /** Token optimization configuration */
  tokenOptimization?: TokenOptimizationConfig

  /** Tools configuration */
  tools?: ToolsConfig

  /** RAG configuration */
  rag?: RAGConfig

  /** Safety configuration */
  safety?: SafetyConfig

  /** Initial messages */
  initialMessages?: CoreMessage[]

  /** Event callbacks */
  onEvent?: (event: ClarityEvent) => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatAppReturn {
  // Core chat state
  messages: CoreMessage[]
  append: (message: CoreMessage | string) => Promise<void>
  reload: () => Promise<void>
  stop: () => void
  setMessages: (messages: CoreMessage[]) => void

  // Input state
  input: string
  setInput: (input: string) => void
  handleSubmit: (e?: React.FormEvent) => void
  handleInputChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void

  // Loading/error state
  isLoading: boolean
  error: Error | null

  // Memory integration
  memory: MemoryContext | null
  memoryStats: MemoryStats | null

  // Tools integration
  tools: ToolDefinition[]
  pendingToolCalls: ToolCall[]
  executeToolCall: (toolCallId: string) => Promise<void>

  // Token optimization
  tokenStats: TokenStats | null

  // RAG integration
  ragContext: RAGContext | null

  // Safety
  safetyStats: SafetyStats | null

  // Meta information
  meta: ClarityMeta
}
```

---

### useClarityChat

Primary hook for chat state management with built-in memory integration.

```tsx
import { useClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const {
  messages,
  append,
  reload,
  stop,
  isLoading,
  error,
  setMessages,
  input,
  setInput,
  memoryInfo,
  tokenStats
} = useClarityChat({
  api: '/api/chat',
  memory: {
    enabled: true,
    strategy: 'vector-store',
    maxTokens: 8000
  },
  promptOptimization: {
    enabled: true,
    targetTokens: 4000
  }
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL */
  api: string

  /** Initial messages */
  initialMessages?: CoreMessage[]

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: ClarityMemoryOptions

  /** Transport protocol */
  transport?: 'sse' | 'websocket'

  /** WebSocket options */
  websocket?: ClarityWebSocketOptions

  /** Prompt optimization */
  promptOptimization?: ClarityPromptOptimizationOptions

  /** Custom headers */
  headers?: Record<string, string>

  /** Request body */
  body?: Record<string, unknown>

  /** Credentials mode */
  credentials?: RequestCredentials

  /** Streaming enabled */
  streamProtocol?: 'data' | 'text'

  /** Callbacks */
  onResponse?: (response: Response) => void
  onFinish?: (message: CoreMessage) => void
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
}

interface ClarityMemoryOptions {
  /** Enable memory */
  enabled?: boolean

  /** Auto-capture messages */
  autoCapture?: boolean

  /** Require consent */
  requireConsent?: boolean

  /** Consent callback */
  onConsentRequired?: () => Promise<boolean> | boolean

  /** Memory strategy */
  strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'

  /** Maximum tokens */
  maxTokens?: number

  /** Retry on error */
  retryOnError?: boolean

  /** Max retry attempts */
  maxRetryAttempts?: number

  /** Error callback */
  onMemoryError?: (error: Error, operation: 'query' | 'store') => void
}

interface ClarityPromptOptimizationOptions {
  /** Enable optimization */
  enabled?: boolean

  /** Target token budget */
  targetTokens?: number

  /** Optimization strategy */
  strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'summarize-old' | 'drop-low-priority' | 'hybrid'

  /** Model for token counting */
  model?: string

  /** Message priorities */
  priorities?: Array<{ messageId: string; priority: number }>

  /** Summarization function */
  summarizeFn?: (messages: CoreMessage[]) => Promise<string> | string

  /** Number of recent messages to keep */
  keepRecent?: number
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatReturn {
  // Core state
  messages: CoreMessage[]
  append: (message: CoreMessage | string, options?: AppendOptions) => Promise<string | null | undefined>
  reload: (options?: ReloadOptions) => Promise<string | null | undefined>
  stop: () => void
  setMessages: (messages: CoreMessage[] | ((messages: CoreMessage[]) => CoreMessage[])) => void

  // Input state
  input: string
  setInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>
  handleSubmit: (e?: React.FormEvent, options?: SubmitOptions) => void
  handleInputChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLInputElement>) => void

  // Status
  isLoading: boolean
  error: Error | undefined

  // Memory info
  memoryInfo: ClarityChatMemoryInfo
  memoryErrorInfo: ClarityChatErrorInfo

  // Token stats (if prompt optimization enabled)
  tokenStats?: ClarityChatTokenStats
}

interface ClarityChatMemoryInfo {
  memoryCount: number
  enabled: boolean
  strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'
  lastContextSummary?: string
}

interface ClarityChatTokenStats {
  inputTokens: number
  remainingBudget: number
  utilization: number
  lastOptimizationReason?: string
  wasOptimized: boolean
}
```

---

### useClarityChatWithTools

Chat with tool/function calling support.

```tsx
import { useClarityChatWithTools } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const {
  messages,
  append,
  tools,
  pendingToolCalls,
  executeTool,
  toolResults
} = useClarityChatWithTools({
  api: '/api/chat',
  tools: [
    {
      name: 'search',
      description: 'Search the web',
      parameters: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          query: { type: 'string' }
        }
      },
      execute: async ({ query }) => {
        // Implementation
        return { results: [] }
      }
    }
  ]
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatWithToolsOptions extends UseClarityChatOptions {
  /** Tool definitions */
  tools: ToolDefinition[]

  /** Auto-execute tools */
  autoExecute?: boolean

  /** Tool execution confirmation */
  requireConfirmation?: boolean

  /** Tool timeout (ms) */
  toolTimeout?: number

  /** Tool error handler */
  onToolError?: (tool: string, error: Error) => void
}

interface ToolDefinition {
  /** Tool name */
  name: string

  /** Tool description */
  description: string

  /** JSON Schema for parameters */
  parameters: Record<string, unknown>

  /** Execution function */
  execute: (params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>

  /** Requires confirmation */
  requiresConfirmation?: boolean

  /** Category for grouping */
  category?: string
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatWithToolsReturn extends UseClarityChatReturn {
  /** Available tools */
  tools: ToolDefinition[]

  /** Execute a tool */
  executeTool: (toolCallId: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>

  /** Pending tool calls awaiting execution */
  pendingToolCalls: ToolCall[]

  /** Results from executed tools */
  toolResults: Map<string, unknown>

  /** Approve a pending tool call */
  approveTool: (toolCallId: string) => Promise<void>

  /** Reject a pending tool call */
  rejectTool: (toolCallId: string) => void
}
```

---

### useStreamingSSE

Server-Sent Events streaming hook.

```tsx
import { useStreamingSSE } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const {
  connect,
  disconnect,
  isConnected,
  lastEvent,
  error
} = useStreamingSSE({
  url: '/api/stream',
  onMessage: (event) => console.log(event)
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseStreamingSSEOptions {
  /** SSE endpoint URL */
  url: string

  /** Message handler */
  onMessage?: (event: MessageEvent) => void

  /** Open handler */
  onOpen?: () => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Event) => void

  /** Close handler */
  onClose?: () => void

  /** Auto-reconnect */
  autoReconnect?: boolean

  /** Reconnect delay (ms) */
  reconnectDelay?: number

  /** Max reconnect attempts */
  maxReconnectAttempts?: number

  /** Custom headers */
  headers?: Record<string, string>

  /** With credentials */
  withCredentials?: boolean
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseStreamingSSEReturn {
  /** Connect to SSE endpoint */
  connect: () => void

  /** Disconnect from SSE */
  disconnect: () => void

  /** Connection status */
  isConnected: boolean

  /** Last received event */
  lastEvent: MessageEvent | null

  /** Connection error */
  error: Event | null

  /** Reconnect count */
  reconnectCount: number
}
```

### useStreamingWebSocket

WebSocket streaming with automatic reconnection.

```tsx
import { useStreamingWebSocket } from '@clarity-chat/react'

const {
  connect,
  disconnect,
  send,
  isConnected,
  lastMessage
} = useStreamingWebSocket({
  url: 'wss://api.example.com/ws',
  onMessage: (data) => console.log(data)
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseStreamingWebSocketOptions {
  /** WebSocket URL */
  url: string

  /** Message handler */
  onMessage?: (data: unknown) => void

  /** Open handler */
  onOpen?: () => void

  /** Close handler */
  onClose?: (event: CloseEvent) => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Event) => void

  /** Auto-reconnect */
  autoReconnect?: boolean

  /** Reconnect delay (ms) */
  reconnectDelay?: number

  /** Max reconnect attempts */
  maxReconnectAttempts?: number

  /** Heartbeat interval (ms) */
  heartbeatInterval?: number

  /** Protocols */
  protocols?: string | string[]
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseStreamingWebSocketReturn {
  /** Connect to WebSocket */
  connect: () => void

  /** Disconnect from WebSocket */
  disconnect: () => void

  /** Send message */
  send: (data: unknown) => void

  /** Connection status */
  isConnected: boolean

  /** Last received message */
  lastMessage: unknown | null

  /** Ready state */
  readyState: number

  /** Reconnect count */
  reconnectCount: number
}
```

### useTokenOptimization

Unified token optimization hook.

```tsx
import { useTokenOptimization } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const {
  count,
  estimate,
  optimize,
  cache,
  stats
} = useTokenOptimization({
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  preset: 'balanced'
})
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseTokenOptimizationConfig {
  /** Model ID for token counting */
  model?: ModelId

  /** Optimization preset */
  preset?: TokenOptimizationPreset

  /** Enable caching */
  caching?: boolean

  /** Cache configuration */
  cacheConfig?: TieredCacheConfig

  /** Compression enabled */
  compression?: boolean

  /** Compression strategy */
  compressionStrategy?: 'llmlingua' | 'extractive' | 'adaptive'

  /** Quality gate */
  qualityGate?: QualityGateConfig

  /** Cost awareness */
  costAware?: CostAwareConfig
}

type TokenOptimizationPreset = 'minimal' | 'balanced' | 'aggressive' | 'quality-first'
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseTokenOptimizationReturn {
  /** Count tokens in text */
  count: (text: string) => number

  /** Estimate tokens with cost */
  estimate: (text: string) => TokenEstimate

  /** Optimize text for token budget */
  optimize: (text: string, targetTokens: number) => OptimizationResult

  /** Cache operations */
  cache: {
    get: (key: string) => CachedEntry | null
    set: (key: string, value: unknown) => void
    invalidate: (key: string) => void
    stats: CacheStats
  }

  /** Optimization statistics */
  stats: OptimizationStats
}
```

### useTokenCount

Simple token counting hook.

```tsx
import { useTokenCount } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

function TokenDisplay({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const { count, isLoading, error } = useTokenCount(text, {
    model: 'gpt-4o',
    debounceMs: 100
  })

  return <span>{count} tokens</span>
}
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseTokenCountOptions {
  /** Model for token counting */
  model?: ModelId

  /** Debounce delay (ms) */
  debounceMs?: number

  /** Enable caching */
  cache?: boolean

  /** Skip counting when empty */
  skipEmpty?: boolean
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseTokenCountReturn {
  /** Token count */
  count: number

  /** Loading state */
  isLoading: boolean

  /** Error state */
  error: Error | null

  /** Manually recount */
  recount: () => void
}
```

### useModelRouter

Dynamic model selection based on task complexity.

```tsx
import { useModelRouter } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const {
  selectModel,
  currentModel,
  routingStats
} = useModelRouter({
  strategy: 'cost-optimized',
  models: {
    simple: 'gpt-4o-mini',
    moderate: 'gpt-4o',
    complex: 'claude-3-opus'
  }
})

// In your chat logic
const model = selectModel(userMessage)
```

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseModelRouterConfig {
  /** Routing strategy */
  strategy?: RoutingStrategy

  /** Model mapping by complexity */
  models?: {
    simple?: ModelId
    moderate?: ModelId
    complex?: ModelId
  }

  /** Custom routing rules */
  rules?: RoutingRule[]

  /** Fallback model */
  fallbackModel?: ModelId

  /** Cost budget */
  costBudget?: number

  /** Latency budget (ms) */
  latencyBudget?: number
}

type RoutingStrategy = 'cost-optimized' | 'quality-optimized' | 'balanced' | 'latency-optimized'
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseModelRouterReturn {
  /** Select model for a task */
  selectModel: (input: string | RoutingOptions) => ModelId

  /** Currently selected model */
  currentModel: ModelId

  /** Add custom routing rule */
  addRule: (rule: RoutingRule) => void

  /** Routing statistics */
  routingStats: RouterStats
}
```

## Memory Package

### clarityMemory

Zero-config memory factory function.

```typescript
import { clarityMemory } from '@clarity-chat/memory'

// Zero-config usage
const mem = clarityMemory()
await mem.add("User prefers TypeScript", { type: 'semantic', importance: 0.9 })
const results = await mem.recall("user preferences")

// With configuration
const mem = clarityMemory({
  storage: { type: 'indexeddb' },
  embeddingProvider: { provider: 'openai', apiKey: '...' }
})
```

**Configuration:**

```typescript
interface ClarityMemoryConfig {
  /** Storage configuration */
  storage?: {
    type: 'memory' | 'indexeddb' | 'custom'
    config?: StorageConfig
  }

  /** Embedding provider */
  embeddingProvider?: {
    provider: 'openai' | 'cohere' | 'custom'
    apiKey?: string
    model?: string
  }

  /** Memory decay */
  decay?: DecayManagerConfig

  /** Token budget */
  tokenBudget?: TokenBudgetConfig

  /** Consent management */
  consent?: ConsentConfig
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface ClarityMemoryInstance {
  /** Add memory item */
  add: (content: string, metadata?: MemoryMetadata) => Promise<MemoryItem>

  /** Recall memories */
  recall: (query: string, options?: RecallOptions) => Promise<MemorySearchResult[]>

  /** Update memory item */
  update: (id: string, content: string, metadata?: MemoryMetadata) => Promise<MemoryItem>

  /** Delete memory item */
  delete: (id: string) => Promise<void>

  /** Clear all memories */
  clear: () => Promise<void>

  /** Get statistics */
  stats: () => Promise<MemoryStats>

  /** Export memories */
  export: (options?: ExportOptions) => Promise<DataExportResult>

  /** Consent operations */
  consent: ConsentManager

  /** Audit logger */
  audit: AuditLogger
}
```

### LLMSummarizer

import { LLMSummarizer, createSummarizerWithFallback } from '@clarity-chat/memory'

const summarizer = new LLMSummarizer({
  provider: 'openai',

interface LLMSummarizationConfig {

### DecayManager

Memory decay and forgetting management.

```typescript
import { DecayManager, createDecayManager } from '@clarity-chat/memory'

const decayManager = createDecayManager({
  policy: 'exponential',
  halfLife: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 days
  minImportance: 0.1
})

const decayedMemories = decayManager.applyDecay(memories)
```

**Configuration:**

```typescript
interface DecayManagerConfig {
  /** Decay policy */
  policy: DecayPolicy

  /** Half-life for exponential decay (ms) */
  halfLife?: number

  /** Minimum importance before removal */
  minImportance?: number

  /** Custom decay curve */
  decayCurve?: DecayCurve

  /** Access boost factor */
  accessBoost?: number
}

type DecayPolicy = 'none' | 'linear' | 'exponential' | 'step' | 'custom'
```

### ConsentManager

GDPR/CCPA compliance consent management.

```typescript
import { ConsentManager } from '@clarity-chat/memory'

const consentManager = new ConsentManager({
  storageKey: 'clarity-consent',
  purposes: ['memory', 'analytics']
})

const hasConsent = await consentManager.checkConsent('memory')
await consentManager.grantConsent('memory')
```

**Types:**

```typescript
interface ConsentManager {
  /** Check if consent granted */
  checkConsent: (purpose: ConsentPurpose) => Promise<boolean>

  /** Grant consent */
  grantConsent: (purpose: ConsentPurpose) => Promise<void>

  /** Revoke consent */
  revokeConsent: (purpose: ConsentPurpose) => Promise<void>

  /** Get consent record */
  getRecord: () => Promise<ConsentRecord>

  /** Verify consent */
  verify: () => Promise<ConsentVerification>
}

type ConsentPurpose = 'memory' | 'analytics' | 'personalization' | 'marketing'
```

  type: 'DATA_ACCESS',

## Token Optimization Package

### AccurateTokenCounter

Accurate token counting using gpt-tokenizer.

```typescript
import { AccurateTokenCounter } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const counter = new AccurateTokenCounter({
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  cache: true
})

const count = counter.count('Hello, world!')
const messageCount = counter.countMessages([
  { role: 'user', content: 'Hello' },
  { role: 'assistant', content: 'Hi there!' }
])
```

---

### ModelRouter

Model routing based on complexity analysis.

```typescript
import { ModelRouter, RoutingStrategy } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

// Using defaults
const router = ModelRouter.default()

// Using builder
const router = ModelRouter.builder()
  .useOpenAIModels()
  .withStrategy(RoutingStrategy.CostOptimized)
  .withFallback('gpt-4o-mini')
  .build()

const model = router.selectModel('complex technical question')
```

---

### TieredCache

Multi-tier caching system.

```typescript
import { TieredCache } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const cache = new TieredCache({
  tiers: [
    { name: 'exact', maxSize: 1000, ttl: 60000 },
    { name: 'semantic', maxSize: 500, ttl: 300000, similarity: 0.85 }
  ]
})

// Set with semantic indexing
await cache.set('greeting', 'Hello! How can I help?', {
  semanticKey: 'greeting'
})

// Get (checks all tiers)
const result = await cache.get('Hello there!')
```

---

### LLMLinguaCompressor

Advanced compression using LLMLingua algorithm.

```typescript
import { LLMLinguaCompressor, compressWithLLMLingua } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const compressor = new LLMLinguaCompressor({
  targetRatio: 0.5,
  preserveKeywords: true
})

const result = await compressor.compress(longText)
console.log(`Compressed from ${result.originalTokens} to ${result.compressedTokens} tokens`)
```

---

### ProviderCachingFormatter

Format messages for provider-native caching (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google).

```typescript
import {
  ProviderCachingFormatter,
  anthropicCache,
  openaiCache
} from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

// Simple API
const anthropicMessages = anthropicCache(messages, { systemPrompt })
const openaiMessages = openaiCache(messages, { staticPrefix: systemPrompt })

// Advanced API
const formatter = new ProviderCachingFormatter({
  provider: 'anthropic',
  minCacheTokens: 1024
})

const formatted = formatter.format(messages)
```

---

### QualityGate

Quality validation before sending to LLM.

```typescript
import { QualityGate } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const gate = new QualityGate({
  minTokens: 10,
  maxTokens: 4000,
  minSemanticDensity: 0.3,
  blockPatterns: [/spam/i]
})

const result = gate.check(text)
if (result.passed) {
  // Safe to send to LLM
}
```

---

### CostAwareOptimizer

```typescript
import { CostAwareOptimizer } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

const optimizer = new CostAwareOptimizer({
  budget: 10.00, // $10 daily budget
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  strategy: 'balanced'
})

const result = await optimizer.optimize(messages)
const status = optimizer.getBudgetStatus()
```

## Types

### Core Message Types

```typescript
interface CoreMessage {
  id: string
  role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system' | 'tool'
  content: string | MessageContent[]
  createdAt?: Date
  name?: string
  toolInvocations?: ToolInvocation[]
}

type MessageContent =
  | { type: 'text'; text: string }
  | { type: 'image'; image: string | URL }
  | { type: 'file'; file: File | Blob }

interface ToolInvocation {
  toolCallId: string
  toolName: string
  args: Record<string, unknown>
  result?: unknown
  state: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error'
}
```

### Memory Types

```typescript
interface MemoryItem {
  id: string
  content: string
  type: MemoryType
  scope: MemoryScope
  priority: MemoryPriority
  importance: number
  embedding?: number[]
  metadata: MemoryMetadata
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
  accessCount: number
  lastAccessedAt: Date
}

type MemoryType = 'semantic' | 'episodic' | 'procedural' | 'working'
type MemoryScope = 'session' | 'conversation' | 'user' | 'global'
type MemoryPriority = 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'

interface MemorySearchResult {
  item: MemoryItem
  score: number
  relevance: number
}

interface MemoryStats {
  totalItems: number
  totalTokens: number
  byType: Record<MemoryType, number>
  byScope: Record<MemoryScope, number>
  averageImportance: number
}
```

### Token Types

```typescript
interface TokenEstimate {
  tokens: number
  cost: CostEstimate
  model: ModelId
}

interface CostEstimate {
  inputCost: number
  outputCost: number
  totalCost: number
  currency: string
}

interface TokenBudget {
  maxTokens: number
  usedTokens: number
  remaining: number
  utilization: number
}

type ModelId =
  | 'gpt-4o'
  | 'gpt-4o-mini'
  | 'gpt-4-turbo'
  | 'claude-3-opus'
  | 'claude-3-sonnet'
  | 'claude-3-haiku'
  | string
```

### Tool Types

```typescript
interface ToolDefinition {
  name: string
  description: string
  parameters: JSONSchema
  execute: (params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>
  requiresConfirmation?: boolean
  category?: string
  timeout?: number
}

interface ToolCall {
  id: string
  toolName: string
  arguments: Record<string, unknown>
  status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'executing' | 'completed' | 'error'
  result?: unknown
  error?: Error
}

interface ToolExecutionResult {
  success: boolean
  result?: unknown
  error?: Error
  duration: number
}
```

### RAG Types

```typescript
interface RAGConfig {
  enabled: boolean
  sources: RAGSource[]
  chunkSize?: number
  chunkOverlap?: number
  topK?: number
  similarityThreshold?: number
  reranking?: boolean
}

interface RAGSource {
  id: string
  type: 'file' | 'url' | 'text' | 'database'
  content?: string
  url?: string
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

interface RAGQueryResult {
  chunks: RAGChunk[]
  sources: RAGSource[]
  relevanceScores: number[]
}

interface RAGChunk {
  id: string
  content: string
  sourceId: string
  metadata: ChunkMetadata
  embedding?: number[]
  score?: number
}
```

### Event Types

```typescript
type ClarityEvent =
  | { type: 'message:start'; message: CoreMessage }
  | { type: 'message:chunk'; chunk: string; messageId: string }
  | { type: 'message:complete'; message: CoreMessage }
  | { type: 'message:error'; error: Error; messageId?: string }
  | { type: 'tool:start'; toolCall: ToolCall }
  | { type: 'tool:complete'; toolCall: ToolCall; result: unknown }
  | { type: 'tool:error'; toolCall: ToolCall; error: Error }
  | { type: 'memory:add'; item: MemoryItem }
  | { type: 'memory:search'; query: string; results: MemorySearchResult[] }
  | { type: 'rag:retrieve'; query: string; results: RAGQueryResult }
  | { type: 'safety:block'; reason: string; content: string }
  | { type: 'token:budget_warning'; usage: TokenBudget }
```

---

## AI-Optimized APIs

### REST Endpoints

- `GET /api/ai/components` - All component documentation (JSON)
- `GET /api/ai/hooks` - All hook documentation (JSON)
- `GET /api/ai/search?q={query}` - Full-text search
- `GET /api/ai/health` - API health status
- `GET /openapi.json` - OpenAPI 3.0 specification

### MCP Server

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clarity-chat": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["tsx", "apps/streamlined-docs/mcp-server/index.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Available Tools:**
- `list_components` - List all components with basic info
- `get_component(name)` - Get detailed component documentation
- `list_hooks` - List all hooks with basic info
- `get_hook(name)` - Get detailed hook documentation
- `search_docs(query)` - Search all documentation
- `health_check` - Check API health

---

## Version Information

- **Package Version:** 2.0.0
- **React:** 18+ / 19
- **TypeScript:** 5.0+
- **Node.js:** 18+
- **Last Updated:** 2026-01-26
